name: Interstitial Lung Disease Specific to Adulthood

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT 2018 Diagnostic Criteria for Idiopathic Interstitial Pneumonias

criteria.description: Progressive dyspnea on exertion and non-productive cough persisting for months
High-resolution CT showing reticular opacities, honeycombing, or ground-glass opacities consistent with interstitial lung disease
Exclusion of other known causes such as drug toxicity, environmental exposures, or connective tissue diseases
Restrictive ventilatory defect with reduced diffusing capacity for carbon monoxide (DLCO)
Histopathological confirmation showing usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) or nonspecific interstitial pneumonia (NSIP) patterns

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical presentation plus characteristic HRCT pattern and exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Lung biopsy is reserved for cases with uncertain diagnosis after imaging and clinical evaluation.

pathognomonic.notes: Fine bibasilar crackles heard on auscultation
searchTerms: soft crackling noises when breathing in
worsening shortness of breath with activity
weakness related to low blood oxygen
reduced food intake and weight drop
symptoms of high lung blood pressure
breathlessness and syncope from lung pressure

laboratory: Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) or C-reactive protein (CRP) in some cases
Normal or mild hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
imaging: High-resolution CT showing reticular opacities, honeycombing, traction bronchiectasis
Possible ground-glass opacities in early disease
genetic: No specific genetic markers identified; familial cases reported rarely
other: Pulmonary function tests showing restrictive pattern with decreased total lung capacity and DLCO
Lung biopsy demonstrating usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) or nonspecific interstitial pneumonia (NSIP) patterns

distinguishingFeatures: UIP pattern on HRCT or biopsy
Systemic symptoms such as arthritis or rash

redFlags: Signs of pulmonary hypertension or right heart failure
references: American Thoracic Society/European Respiratory Society International Multidisciplinary Consensus Classification of the Idiopathic Interstitial Pneumonias, 2013
Orphanet: Interstitial lung disease specific to adulthood - ORPHA:264735
Cottin V, et al. Interstitial lung disease in adults: diagnosis and management. Lancet Respir Med. 2018
